name: Akutagawa Izumi
source:
A third-year student majoring in Foreign Studies.

He is a popular senior who is handsome and refreshing.

Despite being popular he doesn't have a girlfriend, causing suspicions that he may like men.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/kimikawa/akutagawa]official website[/url]]
